'Stealth / If this is attacking a marked hero, this gets +1{p}.'

Stealth is a printed keyword and fires from the card DB; deliberately not authored.

'IF THIS IS ATTACKING' IS CONTINUOUS, not a trigger: the mark can be removed mid-combat and the bonus has to go with it, so this is a WHILE_STATIC re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation rather than an ON_ATTACK that pumps once. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to THIS card's own attack -- an ungated static would pump every attack its controller made while the opponent was marked.

'A MARKED HERO' is OPPONENT_IS_MARKED (CR 9.3): marking always lands on an opposing hero, so the condition needs no target. ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO is the other half -- an attack can be declared against a permanent, and combat.attack_target is set only then, so a hero attack leaves it None.
